note: The OLG covers earned income verification across multiple pages but lacks a consolidated checklist matching FNS 1021.1's comprehensive data collection requirements. Key coverage: the 'Verification of Income' page (Types of Earned Income) requires gross wages, hours worked, and lists acceptable documents (pay stubs, pay envelopes, employer statements). The BEACON 'Entering, Changing, and Ending Earned Income' page captures employer name, phone, address, FEIN, start date, end date, hourly wage, hours/week, frequency, and job permanence. Work Number matching is extensively documented for IR and recertification. However, several FNS-specified data points are missing from OLG: (1) no requirement to collect overtime, bonus, tip, or commission details; (2) no requirement to document payment method (cash, check, or direct deposit); (3) no systematic requirement to run IEVS/Work Number matches at initial certification (only documented at IR and recertification); (4) no single reference page outlining all employment details that must be collected when a household reports wages. The OLG's coverage is fragmented across Types of Earned Income, Entering Earned Income in BEACON, Simplified Reporting IR, Unclear Information, and Recertification pages rather than presented as a unified intake checklist.
